owner: Dept D/C worker (child session 2026-11-08, D-025); Pre-registration Officer: Director's brief
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. The USDA NASS Crop Progress report (Mondays 16:00 ET, April-November) carries the national good/excellent condition share of corn and soybeans; futures react to condition news (Lehecka, JARE 39(1) 2014, corn/soybeans 1986-2012), and the first tradable print is the 20:00 ET CBOT Globex reopen. Hypothesis: the reaction is incomplete at the reopen and continues into the next day session (candidates.md rank 37, AF C-2-05, original). Sign fixed: an improving rating is bearish: side = -sign(change in good+excellent %).
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1h, stype_in=continuous, symbol <ROOT>.v.0 (front by volume), purchased 2026-11-08 by batch job (estimate row in data/databento_spend_ledger.csv first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet with ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 go only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/<dataset>_holdout.parquet. A 1h bar exists only if the contract traded in that hour. Every ET time below is America/New_York via zoneinfo; because ET is a whole-hour offset from UTC, 'the bar opening HH:00 ET' is exactly one Databento bar. Roll rule (ex ante): a return between two prices is used only if both bars carry the same instrument_id (the .v.0 mapping changes at a session boundary); otherwise the observation is ineligible and counted. Events: every weekly NASS Crop Progress report 2010-06..2024 (Cornell ESMIS archive usda.library.cornell.edu, publication 8336h188j, report text files; release date R = the report's release date; time 16:00 ET). For crop c in {corn -> ZC, soybeans -> ZS}: GE_c = % Good + % Excellent of the national total row ('18 States' corn / '18 States' soybeans or the report's national aggregate row) for 'This week', and GE_prev_c = the same row for 'Last week' (both printed in the same report). Delta_c = GE_c - GE_prev_c. Skip the crop that week if either value is missing (first rating week of the season, reports without a condition table) or Delta_c = 0. side_c = -sign(Delta_c). ENTRY at the OPEN of the bar opening 20:00 ET on R (CBOT grain reopen); if missing, no trade. EXIT at the CLOSE of the bar opening 12:00 ET on the next XNYS session after R (last trade before 13:00 ET); if missing, the CLOSE of the last existing bar opening 09:00..11:00 ET that day (counted), else no trade. Entry/exit bars must carry one instrument_id. Week P&L (fraction of account) = sum over traded crops of w_c*side_c*ln(P_exit/P_entry) - costs. No stops, no targets; the size of Delta is not used (sign only).
parameters: signal = sign of the week-on-week change in national good+excellent %; entry 20:00 ET reopen (bar open) on the release day; exit 12:00 ET bar close (=13:00 ET) next session; ZC and ZS; +-25% neighbours (fixed now): exit at the CLOSE of the 09:00 ET bar (=10:00 ET, hold 14 h, x0.82) and at the CLOSE of the 13:00 ET bar (=14:00 ET, x1.06, the grain close 14:20 caps it); entry at the OPEN of the 21:00 ET bar; trade only |Delta| >= 2 points (filter neighbour); EWMA centre of mass 45 and 75; one-bar delay variant = entry at the OPEN of the 21:00 ET bar; volatility terciles = ZC trailing 20-session s.d. of 20:00->13:00 returns (IS bounds)
instruments: CBOT ZC and ZS front futures (by volume); micros MZC/MZS for sizing
holding: 17 h overnight session (20:00 ET -> 13:00 ET next day) on about 30 report weeks/yr, 1-2 legs: about 50-60 round trips/yr
data_sha256: PINNED AT INGEST (bought / built after this registration): the sha256 of each derived parquet and of the NASS event file is written to data/manifest.csv before the first gateway read, and the result file prints manifest = recomputed for every dataset
vol_scaler: w_c = (0.10/sqrt(252))/sigma_c, sigma_c = EWMA (centre of mass 60 sessions, at least 40) s.d. of the instrument's own 20:00->13:00 ET log return over ALL prior sessions with valid bars (report week or not), through the previous session; no cap/floor.
cost_model: 1x per side on notional ($50 per cent x price in cents): ZC 2 ticks (0.50 cent = $25) + $2.50; ZS 2 ticks (0.50 cent = $25) + $2.50 (2 ticks for the thin overnight grain book, as the candidate brief assumes); charged at entry and exit. 2x run attached (every per-side cost doubled).
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (the IS read for EWMA warm-up precedes it): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West and the event/day-clustered t of the net-1x series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md: at least 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, at least 2 of 3 volatility terciles (bounds from IS) positive, the +-25% neighbours listed in parameters all net-positive, and the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on the *_holdout datasets in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Verdict mechanically: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3) hold; NEAR-MISS if the deciding t is within 1.0 of the bar (t >= 2.6807) with the bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL (refuted under the row's rule). Before the OOS read, on IS only: the truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; the decision must not change) and the perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) must pass on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Series: the per-report-week net P&L (one observation per week; NW lag 4; clustered by week). Concentration also requires neither crop > 75% of a positive net and July-August weeks <= 75% of it. Sub-periods (information only): 2015-2017, 2018-2024 (split date 2018 in the brief), July-August vs other weeks.
notes: Source: research/triage-2026-11-08.md class C #5 (AF C-2-05). EVIDENCE WINDOW: Lehecka 2014, corn/soybeans 1986-2012 (abstract only); nothing after 2012, the 20:00 ET reopen window never measured: OOS 2015-2024 not derivative. Event file cal_nass_crop_progress is built from the archived report text BEFORE any price is read (outcome-free; parse QA printed: weeks per year, missing weeks). Strongest objection (Red Team, N): the reopen print absorbs the information, so the residual drift may be zero; costs about 5-14 bp RT vs a residual of unknown size. OOS 10.0 years, about 300 report weeks: bar 1.16 annual Sharpe (annualised on report weeks); criterion-4 power 0.86/1.00/1.00 at true Sharpe 1.5/2.0/2.4; realistic power about 0.05. Closed families: H0012/H0017 (S&P gap fade) different asset and sign; none in grains. HONEST PRIOR about 0.03. Firm clauses: overnight-session futures (20:00 ET entry after the 18:00 ET firm-day start; exit 13:00 ET inside every deadline); thin overnight books; no news window at 20:00 ET or 13:00 ET (WASDE days at 12:00 ET fall inside the hold on a few Tuesdays: kept, reported). Family crop-progress-reopen holds 1 of 5 counts.
